current_gap: M02 capture authority is defined, but OPTIONAL READ/STOP invitations still lack a timing rule that protects landscape/body attention.
reframe: the design problem is attention authority, not notification styling: when may digital memory ask without overtaking the experience?

A_IMMEDIATE_MODAL.reason: digital prompt takes first-read immediately after the scene

B_EXIT_WHISPER.reason: one-shot non-blocking invitation after scene exit; untouched means disappear

C_RETURN_BATCH.reason: low interruption but requires latent candidate-event accumulation, tending toward behavior logging

convergence_rule: OPTIONAL event → scene ends → non-blocking one-shot invitation → untouched = disappear / no queue / no reminder

practice_skill_transfer.practice: NO NEW SYNTHETIC PRACTICE; consumes prior no-score/fail-soft/attention hierarchy learning

truth_boundary: INTERACTION TIMING PROTOTYPE ONLY / NO LIVE SENSING / FIELD ATTENTION STUDY / PRIVACY OR CONSENT IMPLEMENTATION CLAIM
status: PROJECT TRANSFER EXECUTED / B EXIT-WHISPER KEEP CANDIDATE / CHROMIUM RUNTIME PASS / NOT FINAL_KEEP
